item.title: Sarah Belle Reid plays the Buchla Touché
item.description: video upload by Sarah Belle Reid "An improvisation on the Touché, at the Buchla Archives in Vancouver, BC. The Touché is an extremely rare 8-voice bi-timbral digital instrument designed by Don Buchla in 1980, with software (FOIL) by David Rosenboom.
